title: symer v0.1.3: symbolic kernel for chained two-step paired processes (step-growth aggregation / two-stage rumor cascades)
description: Configurable symbolic-dynamics kernel: one engine covers stepwise aggregation (Flory/Carothers) and a modified two-stage Maki–Thompson/Daley–Kendall cascade. The common carrier factor cancels exactly in the trajectory equations, leaving fit-free closed forms. Contents (W-numbers map to paper sections): W1-W3 tail trichotomy and ledger laws (results/w3_law1_data.json, w3_law2_data.json, w3_smallg_data.json); W4 lone-spreader theorem (w4_lone_spreader_data.json); W5 frozen-inventory inversion, incl. CLI cli/x1_invert.py (w5_main_results.json); W6 network failure boundary and double-ledger CI (w6_failure_boundary_data.json, w6_network_ledger_data.json); W7 review revisions: gate values g†(μ) (w7_gstar.json), real-cascade inversion (w7_measure.json), negative controls C0-C4 (w7_negctl_results.json), Null B (w7_nullb_results.json), simulated-archive validation with degradation study (w7_simarchive_results.json), 10-generator-seed robustness sweep (w7_seed_variation.json), network CI (w7_network_ci.json); W8 f=3 nested-ledger conjecture checks (w8_f3_conjecture.json). Gillespie SSA cross-check (N=6e4, six seeds per cell): maximum ledger deviation 0.95% (x1 caliber). Frozen-inventory law: (x1,x2) = (mu/(alpha+mu), alpha/(alpha+mu)). Regression suite run_tests.py: 49/49. Seeds, parameter grids and acceptance gates are documented in each script header and in data_README.md (the SNAP file must be renamed to data/higgs-activity.txt.gz). Figure-level source data in results/*.json, figures in results/figs/, original run logs in logs/.
